name: M3_OIS100MI_AddOrderLine
description:
Create customer order lines directly on existing customer orders without passing through batch order entry. The operation performs the same online validations as interactive order line entry and writes immediately to the customer order. If validation fails, no line is created and messages are returned. Batch order entry (OIS275) is not involved, so all issues must be corrected online.

Warnings also block creation unless the ignore‑warnings flag is set. The operation supports manual control of planning and delivery dates, sourcing method and agreement behavior, and returns the created line number, line suffix, attribute information, any product‑restriction status, and up to ten informational or warning messages.
